title: Hanasato Minori — All I've Felt〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, I really like this...!
It's close to what I had in mind!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so is this one...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I was surprised by how many hits my search got, but I should be able to find something good now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...! Th-This one's...!
bgm_area00002
The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Minori...?
You look really sleepy...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Have you been getting enough rest? I know you've all been very busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, no! I'm fine!
I just stayed up a little late looking up stuff last night.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looking up stuff? Are you talking about that variety show we'll be appearing on soon?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's great.
You started doing research after our meeting for it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was going to do the same, but my phone was out of battery. I spent quite a lot of time searching for the charger cord last night.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, for the love of...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm totally fine!
Let's start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. We've really been looking forward to having practice with all of you here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, let's do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Nice work today!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line:
Nice work today♪
Nice work today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Phew... I'm glad that I was able to get through practice considering how sleepy I was before we began...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, do you all have work after this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, we're dealing with a bunch of paperwork today. There's a whole pile of surveys and interview articles for magazines that we haven't had a chance to look at yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Excuse me, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mind if we headed over to the field? There's something I'd like for you to all see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The field?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean...?
Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you wanted us to come here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I thought it'd be easier to imagine things if we did it here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Imagine?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Remember what we talked about the last time we were here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: About how all the flowers would look like the sea of glowsticks we're going to see when we do our show at the Dome?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I decided to start looking for a place in our world that could mimic that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, a place with lots and lots of flowers like this field?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Check out this picture!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, that's amazing!
Flowers as far as the eye can see!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's beautiful...
I can't believe that a place like this exists.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, aren't these all the same type of flower?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These flowers are baby blue eyes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where we're from, this park's really famous.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had the privilege of going one time for a photo shoot. It was so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that you spent quite a lot of time looking for a place with blue flowers, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This field contains a lot of different types of flowers, so it won't ever look like this field of baby blue eyes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But then, a thought occurred to me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It must be similar to the view you saw when you did that show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It wasn't this spacious.
I mean, there's probably enough room here for ten Domes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do agree that these blue flowers look like the glowsticks all my fans were waving around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, our goal moving forward will be to make as many flowers bloom here as with this field.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By the way, Minori...
Is this what you were looking up before we started practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! N-No, uhh... I... I washn't...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. You're tripping over your own words...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Miinoorii?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No! I'm sorry!
I couldn't help myself! I had to start looking after the thought of us doing a show at the Dome popped into my head!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
I won't stop you, but you gotta stay in good playing condition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Think about what would happen if you were to yawn in front of a TV crew.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry! I'll be careful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.
